meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 开启高强度模式,让助手更专注彻底地完成任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望助手在特定任务上切换到更专注、更彻底的工作方式
copy.tagline_en: Turn on a high-intensity mode so the assistant finishes tasks more thoroughly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the assistant in a more focused, thorough mode for a task

howto.what: 在 ultrawork 模式下，Claude 会先打印 “ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!”，登记目标、开记事本与待办清单，把任务分档为 LIGHT/HEAVY，跑真实界面取证后才交付。
howto.when: 当你要求开启 ultrawork 模式、而对话里还没有这份指令时，它才会被读取接管。任务中途出现跨模块、权限、数据库等事实时会立即升级为 HEAVY 档。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 修掉这个登录 bug，给出验证证据
say.note: 会分档、写记事本、跑真实界面验证

say.text: 这个改动按 ultrawork 的 HEAVY 档来做

howto.what_en: Once ultrawork mode is on, Claude prints "ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!", registers a goal, keeps a notepad and todo list, sizes the work LIGHT or HEAVY, and proves user-visible behavior with real-surface evidence before delivering.
howto.when_en: It loads when you ask for ultrawork mode and this directive isn't already in the conversation. If work hits facts like auth, DB schema, or concurrency, it upgrades to HEAVY right away.

say_en.note: Prints ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED! and registers the goal
